reason: A VS Code interface for interacting with DSH agents through independent workspace chat windows, including session management, model selection, permission controls, file operations, command execution, web search, and delegated tasks.

summaries.zh: 在 VS Code 中提供连接 DSH 实例的智能体聊天窗口，用于管理工作区会话并调用文件、终端、搜索和子任务等能力。
summaries.en: Provides VS Code chat windows connected to a DSH instance for managing workspace sessions and using agent capabilities such as file access, terminal commands, search, and delegated tasks.

capabilities: Connects to a locally running DSH instance over HTTP and WebSocket APIs
Provides agent chat sessions scoped to the current workspace
Can expose DSH agent capabilities for reading, creating, and modifying workspace files
Can expose command execution through the DSH agent
Supports web search through the DSH agent
Persists and switches workspace conversation sessions
Allows selecting models and changing permission modes
